messages.subject: Re: More interesting things for a proof of concept
parts:
R Open adds fast matrix computation. You can find examples and benchmarks of this at https://htmlpreview.github.io/?https://github.com/andrie/version.compare/blob/master/inst/doc/version.compare.html

For fast, scalable algorithms on large data, you should also try R Server.

You can find code samples of using both, including benchmarks, in the examples we created for R-Tools for Visual Studio (RTVS) at http://microsoft.github.io/RTVS-docs/samples.html

Regards

Andrie
